content: Telegram Bot API (core.telegram.org/bots/api via search corroboration, 2026-08): sendMessage(chat_id, text 4096 chars max, parse_mode MarkdownV2|HTML|legacy, reply_markup). InlineKeyboardMarkup = array of button rows; InlineKeyboardButton = text + callback_data (max 64 bytes) or url. Tap -> Update.callback_query(id,from,data,message) delivered via getUpdates long-poll or setWebhook HTTPS; bot MUST call answerCallbackQuery to dismiss loading state (optional toast); standard pattern: editMessageText updates the original message marking chosen option. Full two-way incl. free-text replies; buttons ride on the message itself; history lives in Telegram cloud indefinitely; same account multi-device native; groups native. 64-byte limit forces callback_data to carry IDs/refs not payloads.
